user.title: Set up Judo iSoft
user.description: Set up your Judo iSoft water treatment system. For local access: enter IP address. For cloud-only access: enter username/password (IP optional).

data_description.host: Enter the IP address of your device for local access, or leave empty if using cloud-only access
data_description.port: The port number for local API connection (ignored for cloud access)
data_description.username: Username from your Judo app account (required for newer devices using cloud service)
data_description.password: Password from your Judo app account (required for newer devices using cloud service)

error.host_or_credentials_required: Either enter the device IP address for local access, or enter username and password for cloud access.
error.host_required_for_local: IP address is required when not using cloud access (username/password).
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Judo iSoft system. Please check the IP address/device ID and ensure the system is accessible.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your username and password. For newer devices, these credentials are required for cloud access.
error.cloud_service_empty_response: ⚠️ Judo Cloud Service Issue: The cloud service returned an empty response. This appears to be a temporary issue with Judo's cloud API. Please try again later or contact Judo support if the problem persists.
error.timeout_connect: ⚠️ Network Timeout: Unable to connect to the Judo service within the expected time. This could be due to network issues, device being offline, or service problems. Please check your network connection and try again.
error.ssl_error: SSL/Certificate error. The cloud service may be temporarily unavailable.
error.dns_error: Cannot resolve cloud service address. Please check your internet connection.
error.cloud_unavailable: Cloud service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for more details and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Judo iSoft system is already configured

init.title: Judo iSoft Options
init.description: Configure advanced options for your Judo iSoft integration.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to update data from the system (30-300 seconds)

start_regeneration.name: Start Regeneration
start_regeneration.description: Start a regeneration cycle on the water softener

trigger_maintenance.name: Trigger Maintenance
trigger_maintenance.description: Set the maintenance required flag (for testing)

set_salt_level.name: Set Salt Level
set_salt_level.description: Set the salt level percentage (for testing/calibration)

set_flow_rate.name: Set Flow Rate
set_flow_rate.description: Set the current flow rate (for testing)

flow_rate.name: Flow Rate
flow_rate.description: Flow rate in liters per minute (0-50)

water_hardness.name: Water Hardness
water_hardness.description: Water hardness in degrees German hardness (0-30)

reset_system.name: Reset System
reset_system.description: Reset the system to default state
